external_checks.evidence: The repository's existing port 3000 listener is occupied; `ss -ltnp 'sport = :3000'` showed a listener on 127.0.0.1:3000. `curl --max-time 3 -kvsS https://127.0.0.1:3000/` failed TLS with `unexpected eof while reading`. Repository AGENTS.md says the desktop E2E harness starts its own Rails server on port 3000 and must not run while the user's development server occupies that port.
`ss -ltnp 'sport = :5432'` reported no listener at final verification. The full Rails suite therefore ran with the repository's isolated SQLite compatibility mode.
